Summary: A one-year ACGME-accredited geriatrics fellowship spanning acute hospital, long-term care, ambulatory, home care, PACE and hospice/palliative settings, preparing fellows for ABIM or ABFM certification.

title: Allergy and Immunology Fellowship
inst: University of Wisconsin School of Medicine and Public Health / UW Health
Department: Division of Allergy, Pulmonary and Critical Care Medicine
Funding: T32 training grant (WiscART) supports fellow research
Summary: A research-intensive, integrated adult and paediatric allergy and immunology fellowship with NIH-funded asthma research and the WiscART T32 programme.

title: Allergy and Immunology Fellowship
inst: McGovern Medical School at UTHealth Houston
Department: Division of Allergy and Immunology, Department of Internal Medicine
Deadline: ERAS deadline 31 August; interviews by invitation in the autumn
Eligibility: Residents from Internal Medicine, Pediatrics or Internal Medicine/Pediatrics programmes
Summary: A new (launched 2025) two-year combined adult-paediatric allergy and immunology fellowship at UTHealth Houston emphasising research and trainee-oriented education.
